description: This PHP source file defines the SuiteEditorMozaik class, which implements the SuiteEditorInterface. It integrates the Mozaik editor into SuiteCRM, providing methods to set up the editor and generate its HTML output using Smarty templates.

classes.name: SuiteEditorMozaik
classes.description: A class that implements SuiteEditorInterface to embed the Mozaik editor within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the SuiteEditorMozaik with optional settings and loads the SuiteMozaik class.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the Mozaik editor using Smarty templates.
